newsitem.title: USA: Sierra moves to dismiss PCA suit.
newsitem.headline: Sierra moves to dismiss PCA suit.

text.p: Sierra Health Services Inc said Monday it filed a motion to dismiss a lawsuit filed against it by Physician Corp of America in the U.S. District Court in Miami.

The company said in a statement it also filed a lawsuit in Delaware seeking declaratory relief, specific performance under the termination provisions of the merger agreement between the two companies and other relief.

Both actions were filed last week. On March 18 Sierra ended its merger agreement with Physician Corp due to higher than originally expected losses at Physician Corp's workers' compensation division. The same day Physician Corp filed suit against Sierra in Miami seeking performance under the merger agreement and damages.
